appendDesc.Executor, Environment and Deploy: Also covers the standalone deploy messages and descriptions (DeployMessage, ApplicationDescription, DriverDescription, ExecutorState), the standalone Client, ExternalShuffleService, LocalSparkCluster, SparkHadoopUtil, the Python and R runners used by spark-submit, and the deploy JSON protocol.

tour.title: Standalone deploy messages: DeployMessage and the descriptions
tour.description: DeployMessage holds the case classes that the standalone Master, Worker, driver client and applications exchange over RPC: registration, launching and killing executors and drivers, and state changes. ApplicationDescription, DriverDescription and ExecutorDescription describe what to run, and Client submits and kills drivers on a standalone cluster.
